biography: Philip Ellis, the Swiss sensation, didn't come from a racing dynasty. His father owned a small watch repair shop in Zurich, a world away from the roar of engines. Philip's obsession began with a beat-up kart he found abandoned near a local track. He spent months restoring it, fueled by racing videos and a burning desire. He entered his first local karting race at 15, stunning everyone with his natural talent and audacious overtaking maneuvers. Sponsorships followed, and soon Ellis was climbing the ranks, his flashy style and unwavering confidence turning heads. A defining moment came in the 2018 ADAC GT Masters season, where he clinched the championship with a daring last-lap pass. Now, as a key driver for Mercedes-AMG, Ellis continues to push the boundaries, proving that passion and determination can overcome any obstacle. While he has had great success in GT racing, he is now looking to prove himself in endurance racing.
drivingStyle: Ellis is known for his aggressive, flamboyant driving style. He attacks corners with a ferocity that often leaves rivals scrambling. Tire management isn't always his strong suit, prioritizing raw speed over long-term strategy. Under pressure, Ellis thrives, often pulling off spectacular overtakes in the closing laps. He's a master of late braking and isn't afraid to take risks, making him a thrilling, if sometimes unpredictable, driver to watch.

careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 ADAC GT Masters championship after starting the final race in 10th position, showcasing his incredible overtaking ability and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 2020 Spa 24 Hours with only an hour remaining, costing his team a likely victory and severely damaging his confidence.
